### Summary of Changes
Provide an overview of what was added, modified, or fixed.

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (e.g. new retrieval strategy, parser, or graph node)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

### Verification & Testing
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass: `pytest -v`
- [ ] Ingestion verified: `python -m app.ingest`
- [ ] Evaluation benchmark executed: `python eval/run_eval.py`
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive keys logged or committed
